injuries.detail: Powell is questionable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets due to a right hamstring strain.
Smith (illness) is out for Friday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
